reason: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness notification utility: it watches turn-completion signals for main conversations and raises a native Windows toast containing the conversation title, with simple debouncing, as described in its README and package metadata for Windows-only runtime and dsh bundle installation.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 的主对话完成每轮后，自动弹出 Windows 系统通知并显示对应对话标题。
summaries.en: This plugin automatically shows a Windows toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness main conversation finishes a turn, including the conversation title.

reasons.code: The plugin invokes hidden PowerShell to call WinRT ToastNotificationManager for native Windows notifications.
It listens to agent status completion events (idle) and only notifies for root/main conversations, with 1.5s debounce merging.
The FAQ/description notes it appends one JSON line per toast decision to %TEMP%\ds-notify-plugin.log with a 64 KiB cap.
